title: 過去に作ったCIRCUS動画を参考（ヒント）にしてSeedance 2.5で再解釈し、映像の迫力を強化する
content:

en.content:
Reinterpret the CIRCUS video I made in the past as a reference (inspiration) using Seedance 2.5, and enhance the visual impact.  
After generation, upscale to 4K.  
At the beginning, use Flovaai’s skill “video generation with scripts” to start creating the video.
